_about: Development-stage choices for the text analyses (registered plan, Section 7). Every value here is a DRAFT until it is finalized on the development set (all of Study 1 and the Study 2 responses in the 2025 interim file) and committed with frozen = true and a date, BEFORE any test-set analysis. In real mode the notebooks and 06_text_statistics.Rmd refuse to analyze the test set while frozen is false.

masking._about: Section 7.2. Replaced by the mask token in the masked copy; whole words, case-insensitive, longer phrases first.
transformation_phrases: one element in a larger work
significantly changed the colors and composition
changed the colors of rivera's photograph and added text over it

uptake._about: Section 7.6. Whether the RAW explanation mentions fame or status, or how much the work was changed. Words that occur in most explanations regardless of condition (e.g. 'original') are left out; the lists are settled on the development set from word frequencies only, never from differences between conditions.

word_lists._about: Section 7.6. Whole-word, case-insensitive; phrases matched before single words; no word counted twice. Causal and counterargument lists are as registered (bare 'as' and 'to' dropped).

vignette_source: Read from the condition blocks and TransformText values in Experiment/Study1_FairUseAuthority.qsf and Experiment/Study2_FairUseAuthority.qsf (textlib.vignette_texts).

embedding_models._about: Section 7.3. Revisions are pinned when frozen. Vectors are saved under Analysis/output/<mode>/text/embeddings/.

llm_coders._about: Section 7.5. Exact IDs and settings are committed before coding begins.

stm._about: Section 7.6. Fit to Study 1 and Study 2 together on the masked text; prevalence ~ a + v + t + study, where t is 0 for Study 1. K is chosen on the development set (06_text_statistics.Rmd with stage = 'development') and written here before freezing.

dictionaries._about: Section 7.6. The official files are not redistributed in this repository (the MFD 2.0 OSF project states no license). textlib.dictionary_file downloads each from its url into Analysis/text_frozen/dictionaries/ (ignored by git) and checks the SHA-256 before use.

mfd2.source: Frimer, Boghrati, Haidt, Graham, & Dehghani, Moral Foundations Dictionary for Linguistic Analyses 2.0. OSF project https://osf.io/ezn37/, file mfd2.0.dic (version 1, 2019-12-16, 24,588 bytes)
mfd2.license: none stated on the OSF project

emfd.source: Hopp, Fisher, Cornell, Huskey, & Weber (2021), The extended Moral Foundations Dictionary (eMFD). GitHub medianeuroscience/emfdscore, commit 5523d76, emfdscore/dictionaries/emfd_scoring.csv (572,028 bytes)

ridge._about: Section 7.7. Ridge regression (glmnet, alpha = 0) from embeddings to each primary rating; out-of-sample R^2 from cv.glmnet's held-out (prevalidated) predictions at lambda.min; bootstrap CI over held-out predictions; the same procedure on permuted ratings gives the baseline.

party_terms._about: Section 7.6, party focus: how often each party is named. Draft; settled on the development set.

frozen_files_sha256._about: Filled in when the configuration is frozen; textlib.freeze_check verifies these.

human_coding_files._about: Section 7.5. Placed in Analysis/text_frozen/ (they contain only de-identified text ids and codes).
human_coding_files.dev_independent: human_codes_dev.csv (pid, coder, the 12 codes as 0/1, stance)
human_coding_files.dev_consensus: human_codes_dev_consensus.csv (pid, the 12 codes, stance), resolved by discussion
human_coding_files.test_check: human_codes_test.csv (pid, the 12 codes, stance), one coder, 100 random test responses
